title: Robust issue-URL parsing with GitHub Enterprise support
plan:
Implement robust GitHub issue URL parsing with GitHub Enterprise support: add InvalidIssueUrlError and a strict parseIssueUrl that validates and normalizes issue URLs, configure Octokit baseUrl for enterprise hosts, validate and normalize URLs in API endpoints, and add unit tests covering accepted and rejected cases.
1. Implement InvalidIssueUrlError, robust parseIssueUrl, Octokit baseUrl handling, and normalize URL helper in GithubApi
2. Validate and normalize issue URLs in API router for POST /api/task and POST /api/task/:taskId/retry and store normalized URL
requirements: Export class InvalidIssueUrlError extends Error from backend/src/GithubApi/index.ts

Add parseIssueUrl(url:string) that returns { host, owner, repo, issueNumber } and accepts https://github.com/o/r/issues/12 with trailing slash, ?query, #fragment, www.github.com, and any host listed in comma-separated env GITHUB_HOSTS

parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError for /pull/ URLs, non-numeric or zero issue numbers, unknown hosts (not github.com or in GITHUB_HOSTS), http:// URLs, and owner/repo names with disallowed characters
GithubApi must configure Octokit with baseUrl https://<host>/api/v3 when host is not github.com
Orchestrator must build the repo clone URL using parsed host (https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git) and embed token on that host when needed (https://x-access-token:[REDACTED]@<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git)
POST /api/task validates the provided issueUrl using parseIssueUrl and returns 400 { error: <message> } when InvalidIssueUrlError is thrown
POST /api/task stores the normalized URL (https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>) when registering the task and when inserting into DB createTaskInDb
POST /api/task/:taskId/retry validates body.issueUrl (if provided) using parseIssueUrl and returns 400 { error: <message> } for InvalidIssueUrlError; when updating stored task, use the normalized URL

Add Vitest tests at backend/src/GithubApi/__tests__/parseIssueUrl.test.ts covering at least 10 accepted and rejected cases (including github.com and an enterprise host, trailing slash, query/fragments, www, pull URL rejection, http rejection, non-numeric and zero issue)
Running backend type-check and tests (npx tsc -b and npm test in backend) should pass after changes
